scope: New default-off button body candidate: bounded source-plane radiance approximation from live origTex; no generic UIButton scope, no Apple-equivalence claim

app.scope: existing approved NativePlayLab; same GPU self-check control, additional owned input assets only

source.baseCandidateShaderOrigin: previous installed-build12 same-source MSL 5bd8bc; read-only copied bytes

design.model: source-plane radiance approximation; environment direction is projected into current origTex using the same rounded-dome normal and scaled by min(thickness,bezel), clamped to 0.45 of the existing 7/36 source-dimension displacement cap
design.samples: one extra src.sample at derived environment UV; no fixed light colors, generated illumination map, tint, overlay, blur or background proxy
design.transparentAlpha: preserve optical/transmission sample alpha exactly; unpremultiply environment and transmission sample colors only for straight-color interpolation, premultiply by transmission alpha
design.identity: disabled, thickness<=0, scale<=0, IOR<=1 return environment UV equal to source UV and zero weight
design.colorSpace: sampled values are used in Metal native sample domain; RGBA8Unorm_sRGB test inputs are Metal-decoded to linear and render target re-encodes; no extra sRGB transform
